media.title: A. M. Skrynnikowa’s school — examination notice, 1914
media.description: Newspaper notice issued by the acting director of A. M. Skrynnikowa’s Warsaw seven-grade boys’ gymnasium, announcing entrance and resit examinations at the school’s building at Żórawia 49. Published in 1914, during Kaper’s documented period of study at the school.
media.altText: Clipping from a 1914 Warsaw newspaper announcing entrance and resit examinations at A. M. Skrynnikowa’s seven-grade boys’ gymnasium at Żórawia 49.
media.rightsNote: Public-domain newspaper advertisement published in 1914. The local image is a cropped faithful reproduction from the CRISPA digital copy held by the University of Warsaw Library.
media.publicCaption: Examination notice for A. M. Skrynnikowa’s seven-grade boys’ gymnasium at Żórawia 49, Warsaw, published in 1914 during Kaper’s period at the school.
